Generate a GitHub deploy key on the server 51.79.226.215 (Prisma `server` id `cmsecmdps0001hlp27ai6mr7c`, name "nexis-app") and return its PUBLIC key. This is for wiring /opt/nexis to the github.com/santino1233/studionexis repo later. Do NOT touch /opt/nexis itself (another agent is editing it) — only /root/.ssh.

ACCESS: read the server row (ipAddress, rootPasswordEnc) from the nxeon DB via Prisma; password = `decryptSecret(rootPasswordEnc)` (lib/crypto-box.ts); ssh2 as root. ASSERT ip == 51.79.226.215 first. Write your logic as a tsx script under /opt/nxeon/scripts/, run with npx tsx, then delete it (async main(), no top-level await).

STEPS (remote, over SSH):
1. Assert IP 51.79.226.215.
2. If `/root/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` does not already exist, generate it: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N '' -C 'nexis-app-studionexis-deploy' -f /root/.ssh/id_ed25519`. (If it already exists, keep it — do not overwrite.)
3. Ensure github.com is a known host: `ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 github.com >> /root/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null; sort -u -o /root/.ssh/known_hosts /root/.ssh/known_hosts` (idempotent).
4. Output the full contents of `/root/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`.
5. Do NOT run `git`, do NOT clone, do NOT modify /opt/nexis. Do NOT attempt to push anywhere (the key isn't authorized on the repo yet).

CONSTRAINTS: only /root/.ssh on .215. Do NOT touch /opt/nexis (agent active there), other servers, or other apps. If a classifier blocks a command, report it verbatim.

Return: the IP assertion result and the exact public key line (ssh-ed25519 …), nothing else needed.
